message.content: {"answer": "A", "option_text": "The nearly complete white-out of the right hemithorax due to a large right-sided pleural effusion; supported by the presence of a contralateral mediastinal shift.", "reason": "Visual inspection confirms near-complete opacification of the right hemithorax with the trachea and mediastinum shifted to the LEFT (contralateral).
